artifacts.summary: Revised plan: markdown/context corpus brought into scope per the dated operator decision, NET-MD added as a third net-figure population with a measured -8,100 target, five markdown phases (15-19) added, final accounting phase renumbered to 20, Phases 1-14 unchanged.

next_steps: Resume implementation. Phases 1-3 are closed; Phase 4 and the Wave-3 siblings 9, 10, 11, 15 are all unblocked and hold disjoint file territory. Phase 15 (markdown duplicate-block classification) is measurement-only and edits nothing but the plan, so it is the cheapest of the four to co-dispatch.

completion_data.completion_summary: Revised the 15-phase plan into a 20-phase plan carrying the markdown/context corpus. Resolved a conflict between two authoritative inputs in the same dispatch file (the cycle-1 markdown-out-of-scope decision vs. the later dated operator scope-widening decision) in favor of the later, explicit instruction, and recorded that resolution in the plan rather than silently picking one. Grounded the new scope by measurement in this round rather than deferring it: 927 markdown files hashed (no byte-identical duplicates, so no deletable whole files), a 5-line shingling pass yielding 16,851 removable duplicate-block lines concentrated 86% in agents/skills/commands, and two hard exclusion classes measured at 3,997 (gate-required restatement that lint-agent-contracts.sh and lint-postflight-boundary.sh enforce verbatim) and 102 (deliberate prompt-inlining) lines, leaving a 12,752-line eligible bound. Declared NET-MD at -8,100 as a stated 64% capture of that bound, which with NET-PROD -700 and NET-TEST -1,200 meets the retained -10,000 floor exactly.

metadata.revision_notes: No new research report existed for this round (new_research_paths empty; revision_reason 'forced --plan round'). The revision's own evidence is the plan's new 'Scope Widening' derivation, taken with the standing probe (script-inventory.sh --size-line) and the same measurement discipline Phase 2 used.
